note: Everything in game/ that is drawn or played without a recorded asset. Placeholders stand in for production assets and name the milestone that removes them. Functional entries are particles, UI and debug drawing, which Bible 15 does not count as placeholders. tests/test_placeholders.gd fails when a primitive, code-built, saved or referenced mesh in game/**/*.gd, .tscn or .tres, or a binary resource or model file anywhere in game/, is not listed here by type and file, and when a placeholder's asset_id has a record in assets/records.

functional.description: Draw mesh of the CPUParticles3D eat burst (at most 12 particles).
Pooled Label3D for meal toasts such as "+8 energy", the "Regrowing" labels and the "−12" hit numbers. Text, not geometry.

Debug builds only: zone rings, resolver mouth arcs and the reach circle drawn as lines; in the endless sea also the chunk layer (loaded and view-set chunk squares, tile edges, the stream's rings, site reach discs and sleeper crosses).

The strike lane of a tell on the player: a unit quad scaled to CreatureBrain.strike_lane() with threat_lane.gdshader (the inside at alpha 0.25 at most, the thin outline at 0.7). Gameplay UI drawn on the swim plane, not a model. creature_view.gd builds one more unit quad with the lane's material for the start fade's shader warm-up, drawn out of sight.
Label3D "!" over a creature for 0.6 s when it notices the cell. Text, not geometry.
Label3D "Dodged!" rising over the cell for 0.8 s when a strike on it ends without a hit. Text, not geometry.
A full-screen ColorRect with hurt_vignette.gdshader: a dark red glow at the screen edges, one pulse per hit on the cell (alpha at most 0.35, gone in 0.4 s). Gameplay UI, not a model.

Off-screen threat arrows drawn with CanvasItem draw calls: a badge with the species glyph (HudIcon jaw or star) and a pointer on the screen edge, pulsing with "!" during a tell. Gameplay UI, not a model.

The fluid's opaque bottom: a 400 x 400 m PlaneMesh 40 m under the swim plane with backdrop.gdshader (unshaded, engine fog on). The height fog covers it to 97%, so every pixel shows only the fog colour at that depth and no shape of its own; it is the background that art's decor fades into, not a model (micro-world plan section 3).

The sunlit patches: one unit PlaneMesh, scaled to a disc 2.6 zone radii across under each plankton zone (in the endless sea, each zone of a sunlit or home tile, added and removed with its chunk), carrying zone_light.gdshader's soft shafts of cream light, blended round the zone's edge (micro-world plan C7). Light with no shape of its own, not a model.

Camera-facing quads of the pool ambience: drifting specks, bubbles and microbe swarms drawn by drift.gdshader (about 1,560 instances in three MultiMeshes), and ten flat quads carrying the pre-blurred backdrop organisms rendered by tools/blender/make_ambience_backdrops.py. Decor that never collides; the quad is only a carrier for a shader or texture. The PlaneMesh reference is the quad's orientation constant.

The title world's copy of fluid_backdrop: the same 400 x 400 m PlaneMesh 40 m under the swim plane with backdrop.gdshader, so the title's sea fades into the same fog colour as the pool's. No shape of its own, not a model.

The ghosts of the sizes ahead (S2 ghost ladder): one shared unit QuadMesh, flat (PlaneMesh.FACE_Y), each ghost an instance scaled to its size and carrying a recorded T_Ghost_* texture through the ghost shader. Gameplay UI drawn on the swim plane, not a model.

The growth beat's glitter (S2): one shared unit QuadMesh drawn as still instances carrying the food looks' recorded haze sprites, and the same quad warmed up once at the start fade so the beat's shaders are ready. Particles, not a model.

The haze of older sizes (S3, V3-14): one shared unit QuadMesh drawn as still instances far under the swim plane, carrying the size before's recorded food haze sprite (T_Haze_algae_ball at 3, T_Haze_glass_flake at 4) through the older haze shader, and a quad warmed up once at the start fade. Particles, not a model.

The old band below (S3, V3-3): each recorded band-0 landmark and rare GLB baked at runtime into one ArrayMesh surface (its root mesh's surfaces, no Growth_ nodes, vertex colours the old colour of each surface's albedo) drawn as a MultiMesh under the swim plane, and a QuadMesh probe warmed up once at the start fade. The models are the recorded kit pieces; nothing new is modelled.

The cradle's glitter ring and dish (S3, s3-view 6.2 and 6.3): 48 billboards of art's T_Haze_plankton sprite on the shared unit QuadMesh round the old pool, and the M1 pool's rocks and ring shells baked like the old band (OldBandLayer.baked) into MultiMeshes, plus a QuadMesh probe warmed up once at the start fade. The sprite and the models are recorded art; nothing new is modelled.

The creature stage's generated skin: a Surface Nets ArrayMesh built at runtime from the body description's capsule field (game/systems/creature/skin_cpu.gd or skin_gpu.gd), skinned to the generated Skeleton3D with CUSTOM0 paint coordinates and CUSTOM1 rest positions, drawn with the art team's creature_skin.gdshader. Spore-style full-body building (docs/DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-23): the player's anatomy is the model, so there is no Blender source for it. The art parts on it are the recorded cpart_* assets.

The creature editor's handles and gizmos: unshaded SphereMesh instances on every vertebra, joint and part of the working body (orange, blue, green; the selection brighter and larger) and the selected part's turn ring drawn as an ImmediateMesh line strip. Editing UI drawn in the 3D view, not a model.

The mating beat's heart marker: two unshaded pink CylinderMesh discs over a rotated BoxMesh, floating over the player and its mate while the mate walks up and facing the camera. A short-lived status sign drawn in the 3D view, like a speech bubble, not a model.

The cell editor's test drive dish (TestPool): a flat CylinderMesh floor and TorusMesh rings for the wall and the floor's distance marks, in their own little world behind the editor. Editing UI for feeling a body's speed, not a model of the sea.

A stinger veil's threads (S3, s3-view 8.2, V3-12): art's recorded veil_threads rig remapped once into a unit capsule frame (an ArrayMesh of the same strands, x fitted to 0.85 and z along each strand's COLOR red) so it can be fitted inside the sim's thread capsule every frame, and a flat PlaneMesh under it for the capsule's soft outline (capsule_outline.gdshader). The strands are the recorded asset; the outline is gameplay UI on the swim plane, not a model. CreatureLayer.warm_up_meshes draws a copy of the outline plane once at the start fade (T4.6).

A morsel site's carrion items (S3, s3-view 9.1, V3-13): each species' recorded body and parts, as a creature view builds them at q 1, merged once into one ArrayMesh so every item of the species draws in one MultiMesh in M_Morsel, with an inverted-hull rim from the same mesh. A bake of recorded assets, not a new model.
